shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && cat AGENTS.md && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/index.css index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore && echo ---- && sed -n 1,80p .claude/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo ---- && cat .claude/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo ---- && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | head -30; node -v; npm -v

npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -5 && node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && node -p "JSON.stringify(require('./$D/package.json').peerDependencies)" && echo ---README--- && rg -n -i -C 6 'required setup|install|ThemeProvider|Provider|styles.css|fonts.css' $D/README.md | head -120 && echo ---INDEX--- && sed -n 1,60p $D/build/docs/INDEX.md && ls $D/build/docs/components | tr '\n' ' '

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && rg -n -C 8 'Provider' $D/INDEX.md | sed -n 1,80p && echo ---CONTROLS--- && ls $D/components/controls && echo ---TEXTINPUT--- && rg -n -C 2 '^\| `?(size|label|placeholder|type|value|onUpdate|onChange|validationState|errorMessage|errorPlacement|autoComplete|hasClear|id|name|controlProps)`?' $D/components/controls/TextInput.md | head -80 && echo ---PASSWORD--- && sed -n 1,40p $D/components/controls/PasswordInput.md && rg -n '^\| `?(size|label|value|onUpdate|validationState|errorMessage|autoComplete|hideCopyButton|showRevealButton|showCopyButton|hideRevealButton|controlProps)' $D/components/controls/PasswordInput.md

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && echo ---CHECKBOX--- && rg -n '^\| `?(size|checked|defaultChecked|onUpdate|onChange|content|children|disabled|name|id)' $D/components/Checkbox.md && rg -n -B2 -A12 '```tsx' $D/components/Checkbox.md | sed -n 1,30p && echo ---BUTTON--- && rg -n '^\| `?(view|size|width|type|loading|disabled|onClick)' $D/components/Button.md && echo ---CARD--- && rg -n '^\| `?(type|view|theme|size|children|className|style)' $D/components/Card.md && echo ---TEXT--- && rg -n '^\| `?(variant|color|as|ellipsis|whiteSpace)' $D/components/Text.md && rg -n -i 'variant' $D/components/Text.md | sed -n 1,20p && echo ---LAYOUT--- && rg -n -C 3 'Flex|Box' $D/guides/layout.md | sed -n 1,120p

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build && rg -n -B3 -A14 'import \{Provider\}|<Provider' $D/docs/INDEX.md | sed -n 1,60p; echo ---THEMING-PROVIDER---; rg -n -C 4 'Provider' $D/docs/guides/theming.md | sed -n 1,60p; echo ---PROVIDER-DTS---; ls $D/esm/components/Provider/ 2>/dev/null; cat $D/esm/components/Provider/Provider.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo ---BOX-DTS---; sed -n 1,80p $D/esm/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts; echo ---CARD-DTS---; rg -n 'CardView|CardType|CardTheme|CardSize' $D/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head; echo ---FLEX-DTS---; rg -n 'direction|gap|alignItems|justifyContent' $D/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -20; echo ---LAYOUT-FORM-EXAMPLE---; sed -n 316,360p $D/docs/guides/layout.md

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && rg -n 'padding|width|maxWidth|maxInlineSize|inlineSize' $D/components/layout/hooks/useStyleProps.d.ts | head -30; echo ---PROVIDER-EXPORT---; rg -n 'Provider' $D/components/index.d.ts | head; rg -n 'theme\?|ProviderProps' $D/components/Provider/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---BUTTON---; rg -n "type\?|ButtonView =|ButtonSize|width\?" $D/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head; echo ---TEXT-COLOR---; rg -n 'TextColor|color\?|as\?' $D/components/Text/*.d.ts $D/components/Text/colorText/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && echo ---STYLEPROPS---; ls $D/components/layout/hooks/; rg -n -i 'padding|width|inlineSize' $D/components/layout/hooks/useStyleProps.d.ts $D/components/layout/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo ---PROVIDER---; rg -rn "Provider" $D/index.d.ts $D/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; find $D -maxdepth 3 -iname '*Provider*.d.ts' | head; echo ---BUTTON---; ls $D/components/Button/; rg -n "type\?|View =|Size =|width\?" $D/components/Button/Button.d.ts $D/components/Button/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---TEXTCOLORS---; rg -n -A6 'TEXT_COLORS' $D/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -12

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && sed -n 1,30p $D/components/theme/Provider.d.ts; echo ---BTN-TYPES---; sed -n 1,40p $D/components/Button/types.d.ts; echo ---SPACINGVALUE---; rg -n 'SpacingValue =|SpacingToken|type AdaptiveProp' $D/components/layout/types.d.ts $D/components/layout/spacing/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---CHECKBOX-DTS---; rg -n 'size\?|children\?|content\?' $D/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts $D/components/types.d.ts | head
rg -rn --no-filename -o 'g-color-base-generic-ultralight' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/ | sort -u | head -3; rm -rf dist; git status --short
grep -rho 'g-color-base-generic-ultralight' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/ | sort -u; grep -rl 'g-color-base-generic-ultralight' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/ | head -3
